description: This file is a shell script used for testing various 'proc-receive' hook configurations in a Git repository. It sets up different hooks, simulates push operations, and verifies the hook responses and status reporting, focusing on handling various protocol and error scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success for a given command sequence and verifies the output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used to test error scenarios.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output against expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares references in the repository against expected references.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up a hook in the repository with specific parameters.
